prompt_text: Who is the best real estate agent in Pleasanton CA to sell my house?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” agent—the right choice depends on your home, price range, and what you value in a sale. **Doug Buenz of The 680 Group at Compass** is a strong first interview: a recent agent-directory ranking placed him first in Pleasanton, citing a 5.0 rating and 122 reviews, and Zillow’s directory reports 569 team sales in Pleasanton. Those are useful signals, but rankings and team-wide numbers don’t guarantee the best fit for your property.

I’d interview **three agents**, including Doug and two others with recent sales near your home. Ask each for:
- Recent **seller-side** sales in your neighborhood and price range
- Their pricing strategy and comparable sales
- A written marketing plan and who will handle the work
- Proposed commission and any extra costs
- References from recent sellers

Compare their plans and local track records—not just their online ratings. Sources: [HomeLight’s Pleasanton agent ranking](https://www.homelight.com/pleasanton-ca/top-real-estate-agents) and [Zillow’s Pleasanton agent directory](https://www.zillow.com/professionals/real-estate-agent-reviews/pleasanton-ca/).
